title: C¹ approximation of a Lipschitz function off a set of small measure (Simon Ch. 2, Theorem 1.5)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, K ≥ 0 and let f : ℝⁿ → ℝ be K-Lipschitz (ℝⁿ = Euclid n with Lebesgue measure Lⁿ = volume). Then for every ε ∈ (0, ∞] there is a C¹ function g : ℝⁿ → ℝ (ContDiff ℝ 1 g) such that Lⁿ({x : f(x) ≠ g(x) or Df(x) ≠ Dg(x)}) < ε, where Df(x) = fderiv ℝ f x (which is 0 at points where f is not differentiable) and likewise for g.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Euclid n → ℝ) (K : NNReal), LipschitzWith K f → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ g : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ volume {x | f x ≠ g x ∨ fderiv ℝ f x ≠ fderiv ℝ g x} < ε
